_what_this_is: A pre-treatment HARDWARE QUALIFICATION result, not a C3 scientific result. Section 5: an approved GPU that cannot reproduce the frozen parent identity is not qualified for this C3 lineage. Stage D ran the full DEPTH search on L40 and the gate refused the output before any recovery training.
_what_this_does_and_does_not_establish: It does NOT yet establish that L40 is the reason. Two variables moved between this run and attempt61: the GPU (L40S -> L40) and the pinned micro_batch_size, which attempt61 lacked. The two runs produced DIFFERENT wrong digests -- d6d8d7ee and 4cf33ed0 -- so the execution config demonstrably matters. The decisive test is L40S WITH the fix: the pre-ATTENTION parent was reproduced four times on L40S during the packing pilots, so that device is known to be able to produce it.
